download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL to a specified directory using the download function
download_file_with_custom_name: download a file from a URL and save it with a custom filename in a directory
download_file_without_progress: download a file from a URL to a directory without showing a tqdm progress bar
download_file_skip_existing: download a file from a URL that skips if the file already exists in the directory
download_file_atomic: download a file atomically by writing to a temp file first then moving it to the final path
